summary: uri options: owner, remote_src for src lookups, removes guard, return_content (JSON responses are parsed into json regardless), and SELinux fields.
questions: How do I get the response body from a uri call?
Is JSON parsed automatically by uri?
Where does uri look for src files?

answer_card.title: uri return_content and remote_src
answer_card.answer_md:
- `return_content` (false): include body as `content`. JSON responses (`application/json`) are always parsed into `json`.
- `remote_src` (false): `src` on controller unless true
- `removes`, `owner`, SELinux options
